title: 刚 vs 刚才 in Chinese: Two Ways to Say "Just" (HSK 3 Grammar)
description: 刚 (gāng) vs 刚才 (gāngcái): two ways to say "just" in Chinese, where each one goes, negatives, the most common mistakes and HSK 3 examples.
h1: 刚 vs 刚才: Two Ways to Say "Just"
lede: 刚 (gāng) and 刚才 (gāngcái) both translate as "just", but they work differently. 刚 is an adverb that goes before the verb. 刚才 is a time word meaning "just now" or "a moment ago".

paras: 刚 goes after the subject and directly before the verb. It means something happened only a short time ago, and "short" can be a few minutes or a few months, as the speaker feels it. You don't need 了 at the end: 我刚到 is a complete sentence.

examples.py: Tā gāng lái Zhōngguó liǎng ge yuè.
examples.en: He's only been in China for two months.

paras: 刚才 is a time word, like 今天 or 昨天. It can go at the start of the sentence or after the subject, and it only means a few minutes ago.

examples.py: Gāngcái yǒu rén gěi nǐ dǎ diànhuà.

examples.en: Where did you go just now?
Who was that person just now?

paras: Because 刚才 is a time word, it can do things 刚 can't. Only 刚才 can start a sentence: 刚我吃了饭 is wrong. Only 刚才 can come before a noun: 刚才的电话, not 刚的电话. Only 刚才 can go before a negative: 刚才我没有听见, never 刚没有.
刚 can do things 刚才 can't. It can go with a length of time (刚来两个月), and with 就 to say that one thing happened right after another: 我刚到家，就下雨了.

examples.zh: 对不起，刚才我没有听见。
examples.en: Sorry, I didn't hear you just now.

examples.py: Wǒ gāng dào jiā, jiù xià yǔ le.
examples.en: I'd only just got home when it started to rain.

worksheet.title: 刚 vs 刚才 Worksheet: HSK 3 Printable with Answers
worksheet.description: A free printable 刚 vs 刚才 worksheet for HSK 3: 17 exercises (choose 刚 or 刚才, word order, fix the mistake) with an answer key.

exercises.instructions: Write 刚 or 刚才 in each gap. Look at where the gap is and what comes after it.

items.en: Someone was looking for you just now.
He's only been in China for three weeks.
Did you understand the question just now?
I'd only just got home when someone came round.
Sorry, I didn't hear you just now.
We've only known each other for two months.
What did you say just now?

items.zh: 我妹妹上个月＿＿开始工作。
items.en: My little sister only started work last month.

items.zh: ＿＿我在开会，所以没有接你的电话。
items.en: I was in a meeting just now, so I didn't answer your call.

exercises.instructions: Write the words as one correct sentence.

items.en: He's just got home from work.
I didn't see him just now.

exercises.instructions: Each sentence has one mistake. Write the correct sentence.

items.en: He's only been in China for a year.
Who was that on the phone just now?
I didn't have my phone with me just now.
